GOAL: Sign on to the MERIDIAN CORE servicing console as supervisor super1. Look up member 102777 by member number and open their record. Open Place Account Hold. Set the share dropdown to [REDACTED:share_id], set the reason dropdown to LEGAL, and type the notes recorded-capability. Every one of those three fields must be set explicitly, including any dropdown that already shows the value you want. Continue to the confirmation screen and apply the hold. Then read back the status of that share.

ENTRY POINT: https://web-sample.interface-hiring.com/signon

INPUT PARAMETERS available to this run (reference secrets by name):
  - member_id (string) = '102777'
  - operator_id (string) = 'super1'
  - share (string) = '[REDACTED:share_id]'
  - reason (string) = 'LEGAL'
  - notes (string) = 'recorded-capability'
  - operator_[REDACTED:secret] (string) -- secret, reference by name only
